answer: An hostile operator running 22 aliases therefore needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in ripple, expire in zenith, and dune lists each expiry. A farm of 2984 identities would post 2603 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
